nodes.label: Arbitrum Chain Targets
nodes.rationale: Arbitrum Sepolia is used for staging and Arbitrum One for production so contract behaviour is rehearsed on a testnet before mainnet.

nodes.label: Test Strategy
nodes.rationale: Vitest + Playwright cover the frontend while Jest plus real integration tests cover the backend, because API auth/profile paths need a live Postgres and Redis.

nodes.label: Postgres 16 Dev Service
nodes.rationale: Bound to 127.0.0.1 only and restart: "no" so a dev database is never exposed on the LAN and never silently resurrects after a reboot.

nodes.label: Postgres Test Instance
nodes.rationale: A separate database on port 5433 keeps integration tests from wiping the dev database.

nodes.label: CI Verify Pipeline
nodes.rationale: One turbo invocation replaced a 3-job split that reinstalled and rebuilt everything three times and never ran `build`, which let broken builds reach Vercel green.

nodes.label: CI Service Containers
nodes.rationale: Ports and credentials mirror docker-compose.yml so the same integration tests pass locally and in CI.

nodes.label: Root-Level Build Command
nodes.rationale: Builds from the repo root because pnpm workspaces need the root lockfile and turbo must build shared + contracts first.

nodes.label: Monorepo Build Filter
nodes.rationale: Without path filtering every push touching apps/web rebuilds the API and burns the 500 free build minutes.

nodes.label: Deliberate Missing Health Check
nodes.rationale: /health returns 503 until worker heartbeats land in Redis (~30s, TTL 60s); on a free instance that sleeps after 15min every cold start would fail the check and cause a restart loop.

nodes.label: External Neon and Upstash Datastores
nodes.rationale: Render's free Postgres is deleted after 30 days and its free Key Value loses all data on restart, which would destroy the BullMQ queues; Neon and Upstash have persistent free tiers.

nodes.label: Oracle Signing Keys
nodes.rationale: Settler, war, tournament and XP keys are optional in the env schema: the API boots without them but settlement/XP/tournament signing stays dead.

nodes.label: sync: false Secret Handling
nodes.rationale: Every sync: false var is prompted for at apply time and never stored in git.
